title: Implication of dressed form of relational observable on von Neumann algebra
summary: In quantum gravity, a physically meaningful operator is required to be invariant under the diffeomorphisms. Such gauge invariant operator is typically given by the relational observable, the operator localized in relation to some background states. We point out that the relational observable can be comprehensively formulated as the dressed operator. For the background with a boundary where the diffeomorphisms are not gauged, we can use the gravitational Wilson line for dressing, then the relational observable is nonlocal.
